commands.description: Search and manage your Laravel Forge servers and sites

commands.name: check-deploy-status
commands.title: Forge Deployments
commands.description: Shows sites that are currently being deployed

ai.instructions:
Every site and server tool takes an id. Given a name, get the id first: a server name goes to list-servers, a site name to list-sites, and both match on part of a name. No other tool searches, and list-orgs is not a name lookup.
An organization holds servers and a server holds sites. A server can have multiple sites, so a name you are given could be either and you may need to check both.
Deployments belong to sites, not servers.
Deploy failed? deployment-status, then deployment-log.
Site down or erroring? site-online, then site-config.
Server problem? server-events.
Only deploy, restart or reboot if the user asks.
Env file or deploy settings? Call get-site and give the user the Forge link it returns. site-config cannot read them.
A server's SSH public key or credential id is withheld until you name it in get-server's include.
List rows are short. Call probe-api for the field names, then pass the ones you need to list-sites or list-servers in fields. Do not guess a field name; a wrong one returns nothing.
Pass the cursor string back exactly as it was given to get the next page.
Always write a URL as a markdown link: [Deployment settings](url), never a bare URL. Do not open links yourself.

list-sites.note: 3 sites on this page. Rows are short. Call probe-api for the field names, then pass them in fields. Pass an id to get-site for the full record, or to any site tool.

deploy-site.note: Call deployment-status or deployment-log to follow it.

list-orgs.note: Organizations you can reach. The list and get tools use these on their own. You do not pass one.

fields.status: How far the install got, like installed or installing.
fields.php_version: The PHP version the site runs, formatted like PHP 8.3.
fields.zero_downtime_deployments: Whether deploys swap in an atomic release.
fields.environment: The site's env file. Forge keeps it on a separate endpoint. This extension never returns it; the get tool gives a Forge link instead.

probe-api.note: These are field names, not values. Pass the ones you want to list-sites in fields. get-site returns every site field it can.

get-site.environment: Not returned by this extension. The user can read or edit it at [Environment](https://forge.laravel.com/acme-inc/web-1/5001/environment).
get-site.deploymentScript: Not returned by this extension. The user can read or edit it at [Deployment settings](https://forge.laravel.com/acme-inc/web-1/5001/settings/deployments).
get-site.deploymentUrl: Not returned by this extension. The user can find or change it at [Deployment settings](https://forge.laravel.com/acme-inc/web-1/5001/settings/deployments).

tools.name: list-orgs
tools.title: List Organizations
tools.description: List the Forge organizations your tokens can reach. The other tools use these on their own.

tools.name: list-servers
tools.title: List Servers
tools.description: List or filter your Forge servers and get their ids. Start here for anything about a server.

tools.name: list-sites
tools.title: List Sites
tools.description: List or search your Forge sites and get their ids. Start here for anything about a site.

tools.name: get-site
tools.title: Get a Site
tools.description: Everything Forge knows about one site. Takes a site id from list-sites.

tools.name: get-server
tools.title: Get a Server
tools.description: Everything Forge knows about one server, and the sites on it. Takes a server id from list-servers.

tools.name: deployment-status
tools.title: Check Deployment Status
tools.description: Which sites are deploying or have failed, across every organization.

tools.name: deployment-history
tools.title: Get Deployment History
tools.description: Recent deploys for one site. Takes a site id.

tools.name: deployment-log
tools.title: Read Deployment Log
tools.description: The output of one deploy. Takes a site id.

tools.name: server-events
tools.title: Get Server Events
tools.description: Recent Forge events for one server, and their output. Takes a server id.

tools.name: site-online
tools.title: Check If a Site Is Online
tools.description: Check whether one site answers over HTTP. Takes a site id.

tools.name: site-config
tools.title: Read Site Config or Logs
tools.description: Read a site nginx config or log file. Takes a site id.

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.title: Deploy a Site
tools.description: Deploy one site now. Takes a site id.

tools.name: restart-service
tools.title: Restart a Service
tools.description: Restart, stop or reload a service on one server. Takes a server id.

tools.name: reboot-server
tools.title: Reboot a Server
tools.description: Reboot one server. Takes a server id.

tools.name: probe-api
tools.title: Probe the Forge API
tools.description: List every field name a site or server has, and what Forge can filter and sort on.

preferences.title: Forge API Token (v2)

preferences.name: laravel_forge_ssh_user
preferences.title: Laravel Forge SSH User

preferences.name: laravel_forge_ssh_user_two
preferences.title: Laravel Forge SSH User 2 (optional)
preferences.description: Change the SSH user to login with on the second account

preferences.name: laravel_forge_ai_protected_values
preferences.title: AI Access
preferences.label: Let AI read protected values
preferences.description: Allow probe-api to return values it otherwise withholds, like the deploy script and the deploy URL that needs no sign-in.
